machines.recovery: tool activity supersedes earlier completion; unknown never authorizes resend

machines.authoritativeReplacement: RpcNotification | RpcServerRequest | RpcSuccess | RpcFailure; runtime RootModel
machines.recovery: unsupported or malformed replies fail closed; native Codex owns durable tool checkpoints
context manager closes sockets and server workers; failed requests contain no success paths
restart starts fresh; partial samples cannot predict cleanup

machines.oldRepresentation: phase with deadlines, failure/backoff and report facts
machines.authoritativeReplacement: Phase literal; Schedule.restore exhaustive cases; Schedule deadline/selection methods
machines.recovery: running heartbeat on restart becomes error; stopped becomes waiting; output/timeout/worker failure remains failure. Counters and capacity samples are independent facts valid in every phase, not conditional state payloads

machines.authoritativeReplacement: ChildProcess context manager, WorkerReport boundary schema and FailureStage/FailureKind literals
machines.recovery: failure receipts persist separately; failed inspection never authorizes removal

machines.oldRepresentation: branch remote PR states and local worktree graph
machines.authoritativeReplacement: typed provider response schemas and canonical publication checks
machines.recovery: provider failure or uncertainty retains source; provider PR lifecycle remains GitHub-owned

machines.authoritativeReplacement: AttemptStamp, AttemptReceipt, AttemptHistory and ReviewCursor; inventory checkpoint is CompleteRepositoryCursor | VisitedWorktreeCursor, validated from the existing version-1 JSON without new fields.
machines.recovery: reserve before action; crash spends budget conservatively; malformed advisory quarantined, protective evidence retained

machines.oldRepresentation: Decision removed/attempted booleans and a worker result DTO allowed the impossible removed-without-charge combination.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: RetainedDecision | ChargedDecision | RemovedDecision with fixed non-init Literal flags; worker report uses the corresponding strict discriminated union while preserving native JSON fields.
machines.recovery: Reserve the durable attempt before native removal. ChargedDecision includes a timeout, interruption or missing acknowledgement; it never asserts that the external action did not happen. Fresh native readback and every existing eligibility/ownership/publication guard remain required.
machines.verification: Implemented; focused/native full checks, release qualification and production installation remain pending.

machines.recovery: missing or invalid calibration prevents speculative reclaim; measurements are immutable input facts

machines.authoritativeReplacement: ProcessIdentity, PaneTarget, ScreenProcess and verified target inventory
machines.recovery: stale or ambiguous process stays blocked; process-local resources use structured ownership and finally cleanup

machines.authoritativeReplacement: typed native RPC and account provider boundary models; shared recovery lock
guards: same account lock as retry dispatch
machines.recovery: no tools are replayed by account switching; malformed/unsupported account data errors

machines.oldRepresentation: native instance status, tunnel ownership, ephemeral ports
machines.authoritativeReplacement: typed PowerAction and native Cloud command result checks; connection owner context
machines.recovery: GCP/SSH own durable status; failures propagate and owned child processes close

machines.authoritativeReplacement: PreparedFile, FileState, TransferControl and exact file readback
machines.recovery: changed file aborts; failed transfer never reports verified success

machines.oldRepresentation: install marker, root helper, sudo policy, services, generated configuration
machines.authoritativeReplacement: validated maintenance requests and canonical runtime settings/setup definitions
machines.recovery: repeat installation reconciles desired files/services; foreign markers never authorize privileges

machines.oldRepresentation: Import-time default fields captured Linux-only pidfd functions while loading the Mac connection CLI.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: ProcessAccess defaults call open_process_descriptor/send_process_signal, which reject unsupported platforms before using native Linux ownership APIs.
guards: No Linux API access during import
No fallback to unsafe PID-only signaling
machines.recovery: A Mac client can reconnect normally; unsupported native control fails explicitly without signaling a process.

machines.oldRepresentation: InventoryPage combined pending:boolean with an optional cursor; checkpoint_review replaced both fields independently. A nullable cursor.worktree encoded repository-complete versus worktree-visited progress.
machines.authoritativeReplacement: CompleteInventoryPage | DeferredInventoryPage | PendingInventoryPage with non-init Literal pending/cursor fields; pending_inventory_page centralizes deferral. CompleteRepositoryCursor | VisitedWorktreeCursor replaces nullable checkpoint data without changing persisted JSON.
guards: review checkpoint never skips unexamined suffix
aggregate errors do not imply an incomplete rotation
machines.recovery: A deadline before any checkpoint is a distinct deferred state. Complete rotations can still report repository errors. Existing version-1 JSON parses into the cursor union; malformed advisory state is quarantined, never used as deletion authority.
machines.verification: Implemented; native types, migration, recovery and complete checks pending.

coordination: Wiki and Google automation credentials and execution leases are tenant/service-owned. LRA uses neither application database; no shared coordination daemon or new generic engine is required.
exceptions: Native Codex owns checkpointing, tool execution, waiting, interruption and resumable thread storage. This CLI can verify evidence and ownership but cannot promise exactly-once external tools; uncertain input delivery remains blocked.

Independent telemetry, static configuration, OS resource handles and provider response DTOs are boundary facts, not additional application workflows. Native response schemas are validated before decisions.

nativeStorageAccounting.correction: The earlier inventory covered state_5.sqlite only. This census also includes the separate logs_2.sqlite provider database. Table identity is database plus table name, including SQLite-owned tables; no data or provider migrations were altered.

unresolvedProductionEvidence: Explicit owner disk target remains 20% used; current use exceeds it. The daemon reports pressure, not healthy.
